item.title: Regenxbio Duchenne Gene Therapy
item.description:
• Summary: Regenxbio reported positive pivotal trial results for its Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) gene therapy RGX-202, showing functional improvements in patients. However, the data were marred by serious side effects, including a patient death, raising safety concerns. Despite this, the company plans to seek FDA approval in 2027. The mixed results have led to a stock slump and cautious reactions from analysts, though the therapy represents a potential new treatment option for DMD.
  • MoAs: Gene therapy delivering a microdystrophin transgene to restore dystrophin function
  • Sources: BioSpace, BioPharma Dive, Fierce Biotech, Endpoints News, STAT News

item.title: Pfizer EC Approval for Hympavzi
item.description:
• Summary: Pfizer received European Commission approval for Hympavzi (marstacimab) for the treatment of hemophilia, offering a new prophylactic option for patients.
  • MoAs: Antibody against tissue factor pathway inhibitor (anti-TFPI)
  • Sources: Pharmaceutical Technology
